messages:
Priya (AE): urgent ping — NovaGrid POC is stuck. CISO won't sign off due to KMS + egress pricing. Need exec touchpoint with their CTO today.
Alex B (Sales Eng): what's the exact KMS ask?
Priya (AE): they want BYO-KMS + HSM attestation + per-tenant key rotation. Also want an egress cap under $15k/mo — their calc doubled our list price.
Jordan L (VP Sales): @Nina can you confirm feasibility for BYO-KMS in Dedicated/Private and rough timeline?
Nina (Eng Lead): BYO-KMS doable in Private and Dedicated. Hosted: not without a design change. Attestation is doable but needs legal signoff + an ops runbook. Estimate: Dedicated: 3 business days to ship integration docs + test harness. Private: 2 days.
Eve (Legal): we'll need their KMS questionnaire + signature on attestation scope. I can draft an amendment.
Priya (AE): customer pasted their security Qs below — copying the items blocking approval:
Priya (AE): ```
Q12: Key custody: Customer-managed KMS required.
Q13: Audit logs retention: 5 yrs
Q14: BYO-HSM attestation required (FIPS 140-2)
```
Alex B (Sales Eng): tech note — Dedicated can integrate via KMIP/HSM gateway. Private (on-prem) supports direct HSM. Hosted could do envelope encryption with CMK but that's a product/contract change.
Jordan L (VP Sales): action list: 1) confirm KMS path & timeline 2) propose egress cap/discount 3) schedule exec call. Priya, get CTO availability.
Priya (AE): CTO said 4:30pm PT today.
Nina (Eng Lead): confirm again: full attestation (FIPS HSM) may need partner HSM vendor and procurement — lead time 7-10 days if we go that route. We can provide interim attestation notes in 48 hours.
Eve (Legal): I'll prepare an attestation template + NDA amend and circulate today.
Priya (AE): pricing ask — NovaGrid asks for a committed POC cap $15k/mo for 3 months. RevOps list says our POC pricing for that config is $28k/mo.
Jordan L (VP Sales): @Alex @Nina can we present a structured POC discount with guardrails? Need SOW scope and limits.
Alex B (Sales Eng): propose 50% POC discount for 3 months with 10TB egress included, add-on egress at negotiated rates. Suggest one-time KMS integration support fee. Will confirm numbers with RevOps.
DeployBot: [deploy] canary to staging completed — unrelated to this thread.
Priya (AE): customer requests: exec intro to Security + Product, and formal timeline by EOD.
Jordan L (VP Sales): I'll join the 4:30 call. Nina bring 2 slides on KMS options + tradeoffs. Eve bring attestation primer. Alex bring a short cost slide. Priya send calendar invite with objectives.
Priya (AE): invite sent + pre-read link: https://redwoodinternal/presales/nova-kms-pre-read
Alex B (Sales Eng): prepping cost slide now. Draft suggestion:
Alex B (Sales Eng): ```
POC pricing (draft):
- List: $28,000/mo
- Offer: $14,000/mo (50% discount) for 3 months
- Cap: $15,000/mo egress included (10TB)
- KMS integration support: $5,000 one-time
```
Eve (Legal): draft attestation doc uploaded: https://redwoodinternal/legal/attestation-template (internal). I'll tailor for NovaGrid after call.
Nina (Eng Lead): if they insist on certified FIPS HSM vendor attestation now, timeline may slip. Recommend temporary envelope-encryption with customer-managed CMK + attestation report as bridge.
Jordan L (VP Sales): good fallback. If timing slips, offer the bridge and commit to full attestation in parallel.
Priya (AE): thanks — I'll run the call and capture open items. I'll post updates here after the exec sync. :thumbsup:
